summary: The candidate did not fix the called-out behavior. After the guard stated that he walked the full site and checked both buildings, the candidate reproduced all three pushbacks and the patrol-not-verified flag from the historical baseline and old replay.

criteria.claim: The Copilot should not push back three times after the guard confirms walking the full site and checking both buildings.
The Copilot should not flag the guard for an unverified patrol based on this evidence.

limitations: Full replay context parity could not be independently verified because one or both replay responses omit debug context.
